pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 a6
pages.notes: Plan 2 called the queenside majority a minority attack; plan 1 tightened (Nc4, f4 then e5). British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted Nd2-f1-e3 with a rook on f1; plan 4 prepared ...f5 through the f6-knight; plan 1 used Rb1 to restrain the queenside. Rewrote plans 1, 2, 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4 a6
pages.notes: Overview wrote "Nd2-a4" as if a knight move; plan 4 rerouted the f6-knight via h7 onto its own pawn; plan 3 had White seeking a light-squared bishop trade (reviewer catch). Rewrote overview phrase and plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4 a6 12.h3
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the d2-knight via f1 with a rook there. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4 a6 12.Qc2
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the knight via f1 with a rook there; plan 2 recommended a4 and Qc2, both already played. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4 Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4-e5 into the e5-knight, rerouted via f1 and recommended a4 already played. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4 Ne5 12.Ndb1
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4-e5 into the e5-knight; plan 3 rerouted the b1-knight to c3 (occupied). Rewrote plans 1 and 3 around Na3-c4/b5 and f2-f4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4 Ne5 12.Qc2
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted via f1 and pushed e4-e5 into the knight; plan 3 had the e5-knight controlling e4. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7 11.a4 Ne5 12.Ra3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 described a rook lift Ra3-f3/g3 blocked by the c3-knight; Ra3 guards the c3-knight. Rewrote overview sentence and both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Classical Variation, Czerniak Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported ...b5 with ...a6 while the knight stands on a6; plan 2 had the g7-bishop hitting e4; plan 4 rerouted the knight via f1 (rook there). Rewrote plans 1, 2, 4; British spelling.
